ShortDescription.Value: In-game SVG drawing overlay for road, zone, and transit planning before you build.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Skyplan
Tracing paper over your city inside CS2.
Open the overlay with **Alt+P** (rebindable), sketch out your road network, zoning, and transit lines on top of the live map, then build with confidence.
Left-Click to start drawing, Right-Click to end the drawing.
For lines, left-click starts a new segment from the end of the previous one.
For polygons, left-click adds a point and right-click closes the shape.
For Annotation, a small circle preview will be shown on the map where you clicked, a text field will show in the toolbar to write the text, then press **Enter** and the text will appear on the map.
### Disclaimer
This is a rough beta version, a lot of the feedback that i got on reddit is not yet implemented. even the Thumbnail is under development.
The next minor beta version (milestone) will include:
v0.1.2:
* TBD
### Experimental Features
* Planing Tools: * ServiceCatchmentSystem: when SkyPlan panel is open, if you clicked on a school or a hospital the UI will show you where its students/patients live.
### Features
* Line, polygon, point and annotation drawing tools: plan roads, mark zones, drop points of interest * 29 built-in layers: Transit (Train, Subway, Tram, Bus), Roads (Highway to Local), Zones (Residential, Commercial, Industrial, Office), Public Services, and Points of Interest — each with its own colour and style * Fully customisable layers: edit `layers.json` to add, remove, or restyle any layer. Changes hot-swap without a game restart * World-space coordinates: shapes stay pinned to the map as you pan and zoom * Erase tool: with hover highlight * SVG export and import: save your plans as standard SVG files, open them in Inkscape, share them, or import them back later * Auto Save/Load: the game will auto save your shapes per city, and will load them on start * Undo/Redo: (Ctrl+Z)/(Ctrl+Y) * Draggable toolbar * Shape Manager: view all shapes grouped by layer, edit the name and description of each shape, toggle layer visibility and label display * Canvas labels: shape names can be toggled to appear on the map at the shape's anchor point * Visual: global and per-layer opacity sliders * Per-layer visibility toggle
## Known Issues
* changing the styles in `layers.json` while already having shapes in the current session wont hot reload. it needs clear-all for the new style to take effect.
## Limitations
* No snapping, lines do not snap to roads, the grid, or other shapes. * Each line is a separate two-point segment, continuous polylines are planned but not yet implemented.
### Usage
Load a city, press **Alt+P**, draw.
Publish.ChangeLog: ## 0.1.1-beta - Added: (Experimental) Service building info overlay (ServiceCatchmentSystem): click a school or hospital while the panel is open to see capacity/enrolled and where its students/patients live. - Added: Redo support (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), alongside undo. - Added: Auto-save and auto-load: your plan is saved per-city automatically. - UX enhancements: - Default layers for all residential zone types (Low/Medium/High), Mixed Use, and Commercial High. - Shapes in the Shape-Manager is now Collapsible. Collapsed per default. - No layer is pre-selected when the panel opens, preventing accidental drawing. - Increased UI text size for readability.
